description: This file is part of the 'spew' package and contains code related to unsafe reflection and internal flag handling, including build constraints, constants, variables, functions, and initialization logic.

methods.name: flagField

methods.name: unsafeReflectValue
methods.description: Converts a reflect.Value into an unsafe version that bypasses safety restrictions, allowing access to unaddressable and unexported data.
